quarterly_data.signal: Head of U.S. Oncology Commercial Chumi Khurana: Jazz's oncology business 'crossed the billion-dollar mark' in 2025. CFO Jack Spinks: Epidiolex hit blockbuster status last year and, 'with the settlement of our 10 ANDA filers, we now have runway into the very late 2030s'; where three or four years ago the vast majority of revenue came from a single product, Jazz now has 'a diversified portfolio with three billion dollar-plus verticals' (sleep, epilepsy and oncology).
quarterly_data.figure: oncology crossed the billion-dollar mark in 2025; settlements with 10 ANDA filers; three billion dollar-plus verticals
